claims.text: The hardware/error activity on nodes R26-M0-N0-I:J18-U11 and R02-M0-N4-C:J04-U11 shows a concerning pattern of repeated errors.

On R26-M0-N0-I:J18-U11, there are seven consecutive log lines documenting machine check DCR read timeouts, spanning a period of approximately 27 minutes, from 06:41:29 to 07:20:51 on November 21, 2005.
This suggests a prolonged and uncorrected issue with the node's hardware.
In contrast, the node R02-M0-N4-C:J04-U11 experienced six data cache search parity errors over a period of approximately 33 minutes, from 05:02:27 to 05:35:12 on October 17, 2005.

While the errors on this node are also uncorrected, the fact that they are spread out over a longer period and are of a different type (parity errors rather than DCR read timeouts) makes the situation on R26-M0-N0-I:J18-U11 more concerning.
The root-cause hypothesis is that these errors recur without a corrective action in between, indicating a persistent hardware issue that requires immediate attention.
